title: Warm Dense Moroccan Sesame Seed Msemen
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with sesame seeds and a dense, sour dough, perfect for a light meal or snack. This recipe features a unique ice-bath-shock step to create the perfect texture.
instructions: In a large wok, combine flour, sesame seeds, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Remove the dough from the refrigerator and roll it out into a thin sheet.
Cut the sheet into small squares and brush them with vegetable oil.
Heat the wok over medium heat and cook the msemen for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Immediately submerge the cooked msemen in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the msemen rest in the ice bath for 5 minutes before serving.
